overview.short: Chumi Gyatse Falls, revered as the Holy 108 Waterfalls, is a breathtaking series of natural spring cascades originating high in the Eastern Himalayas of Tawang, Arunachal Pradesh.
overview.description: Revered in Tibetan Buddhist tradition as the blessings of Guru Padmasambhava, Chumi Gyatse Falls comprises 108 pristine natural waterfalls that cascade down sheer rock cliffs into a scenic mountain gorge in the Yangtse sector of Tawang. Surrounded by vibrant prayer flags and alpine wilderness, this sacred site offers dramatic highland scenery, misty mountain vistas, and serene nature trails along the high-altitude frontier.

topPlaces.name: Yangtse Mountain Ridge
topPlaces.distance: 4 km from Chumi Gyatse Falls, Arunachal Pradesh
topPlaces.description: The dramatic high-altitude Yangtse Mountain Ridge rises majestically above the Tawang frontier, offering breathtaking panoramic vistas of Eastern Himalayan snow peaks, glacial canyons, and pristine mountain wilderness.
topPlaces.travelTime: 15–25 mins drive from Chumi Gyatse Falls

items.note: The Yangtse clash of 9 December 2022 occurred at night between the troops of the Indian Army and the Chinese People's Liberation Army (PLA) along their mutually contested Line of Actual Control (LAC) in the Yangtse region of Tawang district in Arunachal Pradesh. Violent clashes ensued after the two armies confronted each other with nail-studded clubs and other melee weapons near positions on a border ridgeline in close vicinity of the revered Buddhist site of Chumi Gyatse Falls.
